[https://play.google.com/store/devices/details?id=nexus_7_32gb_2013 On the '''Google Play''' Store] The model number appears to be '''NEXUS7 ASUS-2B32'''.
The '''ASUS''' P/N of this device is ME571K (K008). :It ''should'' hopefully be essentially identical to the 16 GB version, besides the eMMC change. Per the FCC test report... *The mainboard model is ME571K_MB. *The device is using a '''Qualcomm''' APQ8064 ({{WPLink|Snapdragon_(System_on_Chip)}}), 1067 NSP **[https://developer.qualcomm.com/mobile-development/development-devices/snapdragon-s4-pro-apq8064-mdpt '''''Snapdragon S4 Pro APQ8064 MDP/TMobile Development Platform/Tablets''''' on the '''Qualcomm Developer Network''' site] **The GPS chip used in this device is presumed to be WGR7640, the specified chip for the used platform **Additional specified chips for the platform... ***PM8921 + PM8821 (PMICs) ***WCN3360 (WLAN + BT + FM) ***WCD9310 (Audio) *The Wi-Fi IC is a '''Qualcomm Atheros''' WCN3660 (802.11a/b/g/n, 1x1:1) *The LCD panel in use is a '''JDI''' ([http://www.j-display.com/english '''Japan Display Inc.''']) LT070ME05000. *The eMMC in use is a '''hynix''' H26M64002DQR. *The battery in use is an '''ASUS''' C11P1303 - 3.8VDC, 3950mAh / 15Wh *The front-facing camera (1.2 MP) is a '''Lite-On''' 12P2BA536. *The rear facing camera (5 MP) is a '''Chicony''' CJAC53220003870LH. *Chargers mentioned are.. **ASUS PSM06A-050Q (100-240VAC ~ 50/60Hz, 0.25A -> 5.2VDC, 1.35A) **ASUS PA-1070-07 (100-240VAC ~ 50/60Hz, 0.3A -> 5.2VDC, 1.35A) [http://www.ifixit.com/Teardown/Nexus+7+2nd+Generation+Teardown/16072/1 Teardown on '''iFixit''' of the 16 GB model] ([http://www.ifixit.com/Device/Nexus_7_2nd_Generation '''iFixit''''s '''Nexus 7 ''2013''''' device page]) :Per '''iFixit''''s images (and addl. text)... (most P/Ns and all addl. chips are per '''iFixit''''s data..) :*The device has a '''QG-Display''' WD-MP070VB 7" LCD screen :*"ME571K_MB REV. 1.4" and "PCB MADE IN TAIWAN" is silkscreened on the main board. :*"ME571K_WIFI_3DC" is silkscreneed on the Wi-Fi antenna :*The speakers carry a P/N of DN17128L000 Additional specifications, per its '''Google Play''' store page, follow... *CPU: Quad-core Qualcomm Snapdragon™ S4 Pro, 1.5GHz *GPU: Adreno 320, 400MHz *Screen (size, resolution, etc): 7", 1920x1200, HD IPS, w/ scratch-resistant Corning® glass *Dimensions: [[Dimensions::114 mm x 200 mm x 8.65 mm]] *Weight: [[Weight::290 g]] *Battery: 3,950 mAh (up to 9 hrs. active use), built-in inductive charging coil (Qi compatible) *Additional: Micro USB (data+charging) port (SlimPort™ [HDMI over Micro USB] enabled), Bluetooth 4.0, NFC, GPS, accelerometer, ambient light sensor, gyroscope, compass {{WiFiCert|WFA19517|07/18/2013}} ==Addl. external links== [http://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2013/08/something-is-up-with-the-2013-nexus-7s-gps/ '''''Something is up with the 2013 Nexus 7’s GPS''''' on '''Ars Technica''']
[http://news.cnet.com/8301-1035_3-57597753-94/new-nexus-7-plagued-by-gps-glitch/ '''''New Nexus 7 plagued by GPS glitch''''' on '''C|Net'''] (below links are from '''C|Net'''...) :[http://productforums.google.com/forum/#!topic/mobile/prfUDZA7M2s%5B1-25-false%5D Thread regarding the issue on the ''Google Mobile Help Forum'' on the '''Google Product Forums'''] :[http://forum.xda-developers.com/showthread.php?t=2382355&highlight=gps Thread regarding the issue on the '''xda-developers forum'''] :[http://forums.androidcentral.com/google-nexus-7-tablet-2013/300566-gps-problems-nexus-7-2013-a.html Thread regarding the issue on the '''Android Central forum'''] [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3wZRVxWA1DY Unboxing and review by ''DetroitBORG'' on '''YouTube''']
